place_fields.summary: Ranganathaswamy hill attraction associated with a hilltop Ranganatha shrine in the Hassan region.

planning_attributes.description: A hill attraction associated with Ranganathaswamy and trekking; the Hassan-region Ranganathaswamy hill is described as a rocky hillock with a temple and views of the surrounding countryside.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The associated Mavinakere Ranganathaswamy shrine is described as an ancient hill temple dedicated to Ranganatha, with local traditions concerning the sacred stone and the hill shrine.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Road access is available to the hill area; the associated Mavinakere hill temple is reached by road from the Hassan side, with a final ascent to the hilltop shrine.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use care on uneven hill terrain and during any trek.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly; no coordinate correction was made.

place_fields.summary: Seege Gudda is a peak near Seege and Kadadaravalli in Hassan district, known for hilltop scenery and windmills.

planning_attributes.description: A hill peak in Hassan district with scenic hilltop views; a local travel listing describes a Shiva temple and windmills at the top.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The hill is accessible from the surrounding Seege area; the summit is described as reachable by vehicle.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Exercise normal caution on exposed hill terrain, especially around the summit.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.

place_fields.summary: Hosahalli Gudda is a hill and shooting point near Jedigadde and Hosahalli in the Sakleshpur region, known for panoramic views.

planning_attributes.description: A hill viewpoint used for photography and short treks, surrounded by the Western Ghats landscape near Hosahalli.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The hill is also associated with the Kannada film Gajakesari, which was shot at the location.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: From Sakleshpur, travel toward Hanbal/Hosahalli and continue along the approach roads; the final section includes an off-road stretch followed by a short uphill trek.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The final approach can be rough, and a local trench limits vehicle access on the last section.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The broken watchtower is unsafe to climb; take care on the uneven final approach and avoid late-evening travel in poor visibility.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.
